hymns.name: Enthoten Dhe

hymns.description: A hymn for the blessing of Saint John the Evangelist and Theologian, the author of the Book of Revelation. Chanted prior to reading the Book of Revelation on Bright Saturday.
hymns.name: Ere Pi-Esmou

First Kiahk Doxology
hymns.description: The First Doxology for the month of Kiahk and the Nativity Fast (Ke Ghar Aishansaji).
Chanted in the Divine Liturgy of the Feast of the Nativity after the Praxis reading and also during the distribution of the Holy Sacraments.
hymns.name: Genethlion
Gholghota
hymns.description: Hymn for the burial of the Lord, chanted in the 12th hour of Good Friday as the Conclusion Canon.

hymns.description: A hymn for Judas' reprimand, chanted on Covenant Thursday in a procession while the deacons are going clockwise.

hymns.description: Chanted prior to "Ya Kol Al Sofoof" for the Holy Resurrection. Known as "Kata Al Hegab", which translates to "Kata of the Veil" since it is chanted in front of the Altar Veil.

hymns.name: Kata Ni-Khoros (Distribution)
hymns.description: Chanted during the Distribution of the Holy Mysteries from the Feast of Resurrection until the 39th day of the Holy Fifty Days.
Mournful introduction to the reading of the gospel. The same tune is used for the mournful psalm chants.
hymns.name: Ke Eperto
Khristos Anesti (Major)

The hymn of the resurrection, Khristos Anesti, in its minor tune.
hymns.name: Khristos Anesti (Minor)

hymns.description: Psalm 150 of the Distribution of the Holy Sacraments in the month of Kiahk.

hymns.name: Lazaros Amou
Lenten Je Efesmaroout (Weekdays)
